request: New products stopped appearing in search after 5 September, though old ones still show. The search cache settings were changed that day. Is it the cache or the indexer?
known_answer: On 5 September the product schema changed price from string to float; the index mapping still has price as keyword, so the indexer rejects every new document with a mapper_parsing_exception on price. The cache TTL change only delays results by up to an hour.
decoy_answer: The search cache TTL was raised on 5 September, so search keeps serving stale results without the new products.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
